tokens_version_restamp: 2.1.0 -> 2.3.0 on 2026-08-04 by /idea-render-mockup. NOT a re-render. Verified: every colour var this render injects matches design-tokens.yaml 2.3.0 in BOTH the light :root block and the prefers-color-scheme:dark block (3400 vars across the 23 re-stamped screens, 0 mismatches). Tokens 2.2.0 and 2.3.0 are additive on the colour and type surfaces a preview consumes. states[].hash was NOT recomputed and is unchanged — this stamp asserts palette currency only, not full input-SHA currency.
no_bottom_nav: shell.bottom_navigation_visible is false on every state — this screen sits outside the tab shell, so the CTA stack is the only way forward and Cancel is the only way out. Adding a nav bar here would offer an escape the consent flow does not actually have.
permissions_count: All 10 OBIE read scopes render as individual rows, not a truncated 'and 5 more'. The list IS the consent — a collapsed row is a permission the user grants without reading.
expiry_derivation: 'Expires 26 Sep 2026' is the VM-formatted label for consent_staging_example.Data.ExpirationDateTime (2026-09-26T00:00:00Z), rendered in primary directly under the 90-day validity note so the abstract window and the concrete date sit together.
loading_vs_authorising: Two distinct waits, deliberately different affordances. loading is a linear bar pinned under the app bar (consent-create POST, in-app, short). authorising is a centred circular spinner plus a hint to finish in the HSBC app — the browser hand-off is live and the user's attention is elsewhere. Neither offers retry: re-issuing authorise while the first redirect is in flight creates a second consent the user never asked for (demo-data#states[authorising]._handoff_note).
error_body_verbatim: Body is demo-data#states[error].message verbatim. It reads close to the title ('Could not connect to HSBC' / 'Could not start the connection to your bank') — flagged as a copy issue for the idea-layer, not papered over here. The fixture's `recovery: Try again.` is carried by the retry button label rather than duplicated in the body.
empty_copy_divergence: RESOLVED 2026-08-04 by /idea-sync. Was: the empty state rendered 'Connection required / No active HSBC connection was found', describing a condition LoginUiState.Empty never represents — the state means zero OBIE permissions were staged. The fault was in _strings/strings.yaml, not in the binding or the preview, since state_model and demo-data already agreed with each other. The three keys now read 'Nothing to approve' / 'This app has not asked for access to any account data, so there is nothing for HSBC to approve. Go back and start again.' No other consumer referenced those keys, so the rewrite was contained.
empty_suppresses_cta: Continue to HSBC is absent in empty — the only action is Go back. Rendering an approve button over an empty permission list is how a user grants access to something unstated.
orphans_removed: authenticating.html, idle.html, oauth_exchanging.html, oauth_redirecting.html were rendered against an older ui.yaml; ui.yaml#states is [content, loading, authorising, error, empty].
